caption: the sun opposes jupiter today (22° aquarius / 22° leo). jupiter is up all night: look for the brightest point that isn't the moon.

slides.headline: *sun* opposes *jupiter* at *7:28 pm*: aquarius vs leo, big feelings
earth sits between the sun and *jupiter*
slides.body: that puts jupiter opposite the sun in our sky, so it rises at sunset and stays up all night, near its brightest. it's in leo, still retrograde.

slides.headline: the group or the *spotlight*: you don't have to pick
slides.body: astrologers read this opposition as wanting more of everything. go big on generosity, small on promises.

slides.headline: big is fine. make it *mutual*.
slides.body: look up tonight. that bright one is jupiter.
